Recorded claim:
When website navigation changes, inspect all app entry points, route helpers, strings, CSS and metadata. Entries303/304 remove Explore Features across its UI surfaces and change Get Involved to /participate; current README retains that route. The new destination supported localization, which justified dropping forced en-US here. This is a destination-specific decision, not a rule to remove locale segments from every URL.
